import pytest

from helpers import advance, create_edict, submissions_of


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def aval(admin):
    eid = create_edict(admin, "Edital avaliação")
    advance(admin, eid, "avaliacao")
    subs = submissions_of(admin, eid)
    assert len(subs) >= 2, "edital de avaliação precisa de ao menos duas inscrições"
    return {"id": eid, "subs": subs}


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def insc(admin):
    eid = create_edict(admin, "Edital fase inscrição")
    subs = submissions_of(admin, eid)
    return {"id": eid, "subs": subs}


def _comments(cl, sid):
    r = cl.get(f"/submissions/{sid}/comments")
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    data = r.json()
    return data if isinstance(data, list) else data.get("comments", data.get("activity", []))


def test_comentario_criacao_e_consulta(api, aval):
    sid = aval["subs"][0]["id"]
    r = api.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/comments", json={"comment": "bom candidato"})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    c = r.json()
    assert c["comment"] == "bom candidato"
    assert c["submission_id"] == sid
    assert c["user"]["id"] == 2
    assert c["id"]
    assert any(
        x.get("comment", x.get("text")) == "bom candidato" for x in _comments(api, sid)
    )
    # leitura não registra novo evento
    n = len(_comments(api, sid))
    _comments(api, sid)
    assert len(_comments(api, sid)) == n


def test_comentario_fase_errada_400(admin, insc):
    sid = insc["subs"][0]["id"]
    r = admin.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/comments", json={"comment": "fora de fase"})
    assert r.status_code == 400, r.text


def test_comentario_exclusao_por_autor(api, admin, outro, aval):
    sid = aval["subs"][0]["id"]
    r = api.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/comments", json={"comment": "para excluir"})
    cid = r.json()["id"]
    # outro usuário, mesmo administrador, não exclui
    assert outro.delete(f"/submissions/comments/{cid}").status_code == 403
    assert admin.delete(f"/submissions/comments/{cid}").status_code == 403
    # autor exclui
    assert api.delete(f"/submissions/comments/{cid}").status_code == 204
    assert api.delete(f"/submissions/comments/{cid}").status_code == 404
    assert api.delete("/submissions/comments/99999999").status_code == 404


def _favorite(d):
    summ = d["summary"]
    return summ.get("favorite", summ.get("is_favorite"))


def test_favoritos(api, outro, aval):
    sid = aval["subs"][0]["id"]
    assert api.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/favorites").status_code == 201
    assert api.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/favorites").status_code == 409
    assert _favorite(api.get(f"/submissions/{sid}").json()) is True
    # não altera favoritos de outro usuário
    assert _favorite(outro.get(f"/submissions/{sid}").json()) is False
    assert api.delete(f"/submissions/{sid}/favorites").status_code == 204
    assert api.delete(f"/submissions/{sid}/favorites").status_code == 404
    assert _favorite(api.get(f"/submissions/{sid}").json()) is False


def _labels(cl, sid):
    r = cl.get(f"/submissions/{sid}/labels")
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    data = r.json()
    return data["labels"] if isinstance(data, dict) else data


def test_etiquetas(api, outro, aval):
    sid, sid2 = aval["subs"][0]["id"], aval["subs"][1]["id"]
    r = api.post(
        f"/submissions/{sid}/labels", json={"label": "destaque", "color": "#ff0000"}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    lab = r.json()
    assert lab["label"] == "destaque"
    assert lab["submission_id"] == sid

    labels = _labels(api, sid)
    assert any(
        l["label"] == "destaque" and l["color"] == "#ff0000" for l in labels
    ), labels

    # mesma etiqueta em outra inscrição atualiza a cor do mesmo autor
    api.post(
        f"/submissions/{sid2}/labels", json={"label": "destaque", "color": "#00ff00"}
    )
    labels = _labels(api, sid)
    destaque = [l for l in labels if l["label"] == "destaque"]
    assert destaque and all(l["color"] == "#00ff00" for l in destaque), labels

    # catálogo é por usuário
    assert not any(l["label"] == "destaque" for l in _labels(outro, sid))

    # exclusão só pelo autor
    lid = destaque[0]["id"]
    assert outro.delete(f"/submissions/label/{lid}").status_code == 403
    assert api.delete(f"/submissions/label/{lid}").status_code == 204
    assert api.delete(f"/submissions/label/{lid}").status_code == 404
    assert api.delete("/submissions/label/99999999").status_code == 404


def _note(d):
    return d["summary"].get("private_note", "")


def test_notas_privadas(api, outro, aval):
    sid = aval["subs"][0]["id"]
    r = api.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/private_notes", json={"note": "nota um"})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    assert r.json()["note"] == "nota um"
    # atualização não cria outra nota
    r2 = api.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/private_notes", json={"note": "nota dois"})
    assert r2.status_code == 200, r2.text
    assert r2.json()["note"] == "nota dois"
    assert _note(api.get(f"/submissions/{sid}").json()) == "nota dois"
    # outro usuário não vê a nota
    assert _note(outro.get(f"/submissions/{sid}").json()) == ""


def _views(cl, sid):
    r = cl.get(f"/submissions/{sid}/view")
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    data = r.json()
    return data if isinstance(data, list) else data.get("views", [])


def _view_user(v):
    if isinstance(v.get("user"), dict):
        return v["user"].get("id")
    return v.get("user_id")


def test_visualizacoes(api, outro, aval):
    sid = aval["subs"][0]["id"]
    assert api.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/view").status_code == 200
    views = _views(api, sid)
    mine = [v for v in views if _view_user(v) == 2]
    assert len(mine) == 1
    # repetição no mesmo dia não cria outra linha
    api.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/view")
    views = _views(api, sid)
    assert len([v for v in views if _view_user(v) == 2]) == 1
    # outro usuário cria a sua
    outro.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/view")
    views = _views(api, sid)
    assert any(_view_user(v) == 3 for v in views)

import pytest

from helpers import (
    advance,
    create_edict,
    smtp_find,
    smtp_raw_messages,
    submissions_of,
)


def test_solicitar_correcao(admin, api):
    eid = create_edict(admin, "Edital correção")
    subs = submissions_of(admin, eid)
    sid = subs[0]["id"]
    email = subs[0]["email"]

    # fora da fase homologacao
    r0 = admin.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/reesend_submission", json={"text": "corrija"})
    assert r0.status_code == 400, r0.text

    advance(admin, eid, "homologacao")

    # docente não solicita correção
    assert (
        api.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/reesend_submission", json={"text": "corrija"}).status_code
        == 403
    )

    snap = smtp_raw_messages()
    r = admin.post(
        f"/submissions/{sid}/reesend_submission",
        json={"text": "Precisa corrigir o anexo enviado"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    body = r.json()
    assert "message" in body and "email_sent" in body

    m = smtp_find(to=email, contains="/form/", since=snap)
    assert m, f"e-mail de correção não recebido por {email}"
    assert "Precisa corrigir o anexo enviado" in m["raw"]


def _accept_sent(d):
    accept = d["summary"].get("accept") or {}
    return accept.get("sent")


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def accepted(admin):
    """Aprova uma candidatura e envia o formulário de aceite com sucesso."""
    r = admin.get("/edicts", params={"is_open": True})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    for e in r.json():
        subs = submissions_of(admin, e["id"])
        for s in subs:
            if s["accept"]["sent"] != "not_sent":
                continue
            if s["stats"] not in ("approved", "underreview", "waitlist"):
                continue
            if s["stats"] != "approved":
                rs = admin.post(
                    f"/submissions/{s['id']}/select",
                    json={"stats": "approved", "user_ids": [2]},
                )
                if rs.status_code != 200:
                    continue
            snap = smtp_raw_messages()
            ra = admin.post(f"/submissions/{s['id']}/send-accept")
            if ra.status_code == 200:
                return s, snap
    pytest.fail("nenhum envio de formulário de aceite foi possível")


def test_enviar_formulario_aceite(admin, accepted):
    s, snap = accepted
    ra = admin.post(f"/submissions/{s['id']}/send-accept")
    assert ra.status_code == 200, ra.text
    body = ra.json()
    assert "message" in body and "email_sent" in body

    m = smtp_find(to=s["email"], contains="/form/", since=snap)
    assert m, f"e-mail de aceite não recebido por {s['email']}"

    d = admin.get(f"/submissions/{s['id']}").json()
    assert _accept_sent(d) == "sent"


def test_enviar_carta_aceite(admin, accepted):
    s, _ = accepted
    snap = smtp_raw_messages()
    r = admin.post(f"/submissions/{s['id']}/send-letter")
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    body = r.json()
    assert "message" in body and "email_sent" in body

    m = smtp_find(to=s["email"], since=snap)
    assert m, f"carta de aceite não recebida por {s['email']}"

    d = admin.get(f"/submissions/{s['id']}").json()
    assert d["summary"].get("letter_sent") is True

    # repetir não envia outra carta
    assert admin.post(f"/submissions/{s['id']}/send-letter").status_code == 400


def test_carta_candidato_nao_aprovado_400(admin):
    r = admin.get("/edicts", params={"is_open": True})
    for e in r.json():
        for s in submissions_of(admin, e["id"]):
            if s["stats"] != "approved":
                assert (
                    admin.post(f"/submissions/{s['id']}/send-letter").status_code == 400
                )
                return
    pytest.skip("nenhuma candidatura não aprovada disponível")

from helpers import (
    create_edict,
    first_leaf,
    mapping_items,
    mapping_version,
    submissions_of,
)


def _edict_form(admin, eid):
    d = admin.get(f"/edicts/{eid}").json()
    return int(d["candidate_form_id"])


def _mappings(admin, eid, tipo):
    r = admin.get(f"/edicts/{eid}/{tipo}/mappings")
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    return mapping_items(r.json())


def test_ciclo_mapeamento(admin):
    eid = create_edict(admin, "Edital mapeamento", copy=False)
    leaf = first_leaf(admin, _edict_form(admin, eid))
    tree = {"pessoal": {"nome": leaf}}
    r = admin.post(f"/edicts/{eid}/candidates/mappings/versions/1/", json=tree)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    created = r.json()
    mid = created["id"]
    assert created.get("form_version", created.get("version")) == 1

    items = _mappings(admin, eid, "candidates")
    assert any(m["id"] == mid for m in items)

    # não cria dois mapeamentos para o mesmo edital, tipo e versão
    admin.post(f"/edicts/{eid}/candidates/mappings/versions/1/", json=tree)
    items = _mappings(admin, eid, "candidates")
    same = [m for m in items if mapping_version(m) == 1]
    assert len(same) == 1

    # atualização refletida e preservada
    tree2 = {"pessoal": {"nome": leaf, "extra": None}}
    r2 = admin.put(f"/edicts/{eid}/candidates/mappings/versions/1/{mid}", json=tree2)
    assert r2.status_code == 200, r2.text
    items = _mappings(admin, eid, "candidates")
    assert any(m["id"] == mid for m in items)

    # exclusão
    r3 = admin.delete(f"/edicts/{eid}/candidates/mappings/versions/1/{mid}")
    assert r3.status_code == 200, r3.text
    assert r3.json()["message"] == "Mapping deleted successfully"
    items = _mappings(admin, eid, "candidates")
    assert all(m["id"] != mid for m in items)

    # combinações inexistentes
    assert (
        admin.delete(f"/edicts/{eid}/candidates/mappings/versions/1/{mid}").status_code
        == 404
    )
    assert (
        admin.put(
            f"/edicts/{eid}/candidates/mappings/versions/1/{mid}", json=tree2
        ).status_code
        == 404
    )


def test_mapeamento_recommenders(admin):
    eid = create_edict(admin, "Edital mapeamento recomendador", copy=False)
    d = admin.get(f"/edicts/{eid}").json()
    leaf = first_leaf(admin, int(d["recommender_form_id"]))
    tree = {"recomendador": {"nome": leaf}}
    r = admin.post(f"/edicts/{eid}/recommenders/mappings/versions/1/", json=tree)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    items = _mappings(admin, eid, "recommenders")
    assert items


def test_mapeamento_referencia_invalida_422(admin):
    eid = create_edict(admin, "Edital mapeamento inválido", copy=False)
    tree = {"x": {"section": 999999, "field": 999999}}
    r = admin.post(f"/edicts/{eid}/candidates/mappings/versions/1/", json=tree)
    assert r.status_code == 422, r.text


def test_versoes_sem_mapeamento(admin):
    eid = create_edict(admin, "Edital unmapped", copy=False)
    # materializa as inscrições do edital
    submissions_of(admin, eid)
    r = admin.get(f"/edicts/{eid}/candidates/forms/versions/unmapped")
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    versions = r.json()
    assert isinstance(versions, list) and versions, versions

    v = versions[0]
    leaf = first_leaf(admin, _edict_form(admin, eid))
    rr = admin.post(
        f"/edicts/{eid}/candidates/mappings/versions/{v}/", json={"a": {"b": leaf}}
    )
    assert rr.status_code == 200, rr.text
    r2 = admin.get(f"/edicts/{eid}/candidates/forms/versions/unmapped")
    assert v not in r2.json()

    # endpoint dos recomendadores responde
    assert (
        admin.get(f"/edicts/{eid}/recommenders/forms/versions/unmapped").status_code
        == 200
    )

def _senhaunica_login(perfil):
    c = client("CARONTE_API_SENHAUNICA")
    with c:
        r = c.post("/auth/login/senhaunica", json={})
        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
        redirect = r.json()["redirect_to"]
        query = parse_qs(urlparse(redirect).query)
        assert "oauth_token" in query, redirect
        token = query["oauth_token"][0]
        prov = os.environ["SENHAUNICA_PROVEDOR"].rstrip("/")
        auth = httpx.get(
            f"{prov}/wsusuario/oauth/authorize",
            params={"oauth_token": token, "perfil": perfil},
            timeout=60,
        )
        assert auth.status_code == 200, auth.text
        verifier = auth.json()["oauth_verifier"]
        r2 = c.post(
            "/auth/login/senhaunica",
            json={"oauth_token": token, "oauth_verifier": verifier},
        )
        return c, r2

import pytest

from helpers import create_edict, submissions_of


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def sel(admin):
    eid = create_edict(admin, "Edital seleção")
    subs = submissions_of(admin, eid)
    return {"id": eid, "subs": subs}


def test_vagas(api, sel):
    eid = sel["id"]
    r = api.post(f"/edicts/{eid}/slots", json={"amount": "3"})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    assert r.json()["amount"] == "3"
    assert api.get(f"/edicts/{eid}").json()["slots"] == "3"
    # vazio e negativo viram "0"
    assert api.post(f"/edicts/{eid}/slots", json={"amount": ""}).json()["amount"] == "0"
    assert api.post(f"/edicts/{eid}/slots", json={"amount": "-2"}).json()["amount"] == "0"
    # texto que não representa inteiro é rejeitado
    assert api.post(f"/edicts/{eid}/slots", json={"amount": "abc"}).status_code == 422
    # repetir atualiza o registro
    api.post(f"/edicts/{eid}/slots", json={"amount": "5"})
    assert api.get(f"/edicts/{eid}").json()["slots"] == "5"


def _bidding_users(subs, sid):
    me = next(x for x in subs if x["id"] == sid)
    return me["bidding_users"]["data"]


def test_manifestacao_de_interesse(api, admin, sel):
    eid = sel["id"]
    sid = sel["subs"][0]["id"]
    r = api.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/bidding", json={"bidding": "interested"})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    data = _bidding_users(api.get(f"/edicts/{eid}/submissions").json()["submissions"], sid)
    assert any(u["id"] == 2 for u in data.get("interested", []))

    # administrativo indica outro usuário
    r2 = admin.post(
        f"/submissions/{sid}/bidding", json={"bidding": "decline", "user_id": 3}
    )
    assert r2.status_code == 200, r2.text
    data = _bidding_users(admin.get(f"/edicts/{eid}/submissions").json()["submissions"], sid)
    assert any(u["id"] == 3 for u in data.get("decline", []))

    # docente sempre usa o próprio id
    api.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/bidding", json={"bidding": "available", "user_id": 3})
    data = _bidding_users(api.get(f"/edicts/{eid}/submissions").json()["submissions"], sid)
    assert any(u["id"] == 2 for u in data.get("available", []))
    assert not any(u["id"] == 3 for u in data.get("available", []))

    # valor inválido rejeitado; string vazia aceita
    assert (
        api.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/bidding", json={"bidding": "invalido"}).status_code
        == 422
    )
    assert (
        api.post(f"/submissions/{sid}/bidding", json={"bidding": ""}).status_code == 200
    )


def test_selecao_e_orientador(api, admin, sel):
    eid = sel["id"]
    sid = sel["subs"][1]["id"]
    # docente não altera decisão
    r403 = api.post(
        f"/submissions/{sid}/select", json={"stats": "approved", "user_ids": [2]}
    )
    assert r403.status_code == 403, r403.text
    r = admin.post(
        f"/submissions/{sid}/select", json={"stats": "approved", "user_ids": [2]}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    subs = admin.get(f"/edicts/{eid}/submissions").json()["submissions"]
    me = next(x for x in subs if x["id"] == sid)
    assert me["stats"] == "approved"
    assert me["advisor"]["id"] == 2

    # aprovar exige um único orientador existente
    assert (
        admin.post(
            f"/submissions/{sid}/select", json={"stats": "approved", "user_ids": [2, 3]}
        ).status_code
        in (400, 422)
    )
    assert (
        admin.post(
            f"/submissions/{sid}/select",
            json={"stats": "approved", "user_ids": [999999]},
        ).status_code
        in (400, 404, 422)
    )
    # outras situações atualizam o estado
    assert (
        admin.post(
            f"/submissions/{sid}/select", json={"stats": "refused", "user_ids": None}
        ).status_code
        == 200
    )
    # inscrição inexistente
    assert (
        admin.post(
            "/submissions/99999999/select", json={"stats": "refused", "user_ids": None}
        ).status_code
        == 404
    )

from helpers import source_edict


def _find_file_field(node):
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        t = str(node.get("type", "")).lower()
        v = node.get("value")
        if t == "file" and v:
            name = node.get("name") or node.get("label")
            if name:
                return name, v
        for val in node.values():
            found = _find_file_field(val)
            if found:
                return found
    elif isinstance(node, list):
        for item in node:
            found = _find_file_field(item)
            if found:
                return found
    return None

def test_baixar_anexo(api):
    src = source_edict(api)
    for s in src["submissions"]:
        d = api.get(f"/submissions/{s['id']}").json()
        found = _find_file_field(d["submission_form"])
        if not found:
            continue
        label, filename = found
        r = api.get(f"/submissions/{s['id']}/files/{label}/{filename}")
        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
        assert r.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/pdf")
        assert "attachment" in r.headers.get("content-disposition", "")
        assert r.content[:4] == b"%PDF"
        # nome que não confere com o valor do campo
        assert (
            api.get(f"/submissions/{s['id']}/files/{label}/nao-existe.pdf").status_code
            == 404
        )
        return
    raise AssertionError("nenhum anexo encontrado nas inscrições do edital-fonte")
